correctness.rationale: Exact flip-energy identities give iff local constraints for all spins and all positive fields. Run decompositions, independent-set size counts, and hub-magnetization cutoffs produce every finite-n case, including equality cases. A separately written brute-force enumerator confirmed 90 parameter cases for 5<=n<=14 and 105 independently enumerated cyclic-word coefficient cases; checker.py replayed with 195 exact checks. The proof of entropy uses Perrin and Lucas recurrences plus a four-state transfer-matrix spectral-radius upper bound, not an extrapolation from finite data.

value.rationale: The observable is the number of metastable one-spin energy minima of a natural frustrated spin network under an external field. The exact all-n result exhibits an unusual critical entropy increase from log(plastic constant) to log(golden ratio), followed by a zero-entropy polynomial regime, explicit parity dependence, and a separate high-field hub-polarity transition. This structural mechanism is not supplied by the known standalone Perrin MIS count. It does not claim unrelated dynamical hitting probabilities or high-temperature effects.
